target_customer: Millennials and teens trying to cut gaming, pornography and social media use; secondary line sells engineers from India to startups
problem: People struggle with compulsive technology use and want blocking plus accountability.
business_model: Consumer app subscriptions (BlockerX, SocialX) plus a staffing service
product_category: Digital wellbeing and content blocking apps

founders.name: Tejas Balasubramanya
founders.background_notes: Former product manager with 12 plus years in startup product and growth roles per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Cross-platform blocking apps need OS level filtering but are standard mobile and desktop engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Blocking is easily copied and OS vendors ship screen time controls; peer support content is the only differentiator.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Platform screen time controls overlap but no acquisition or copying event found.

market_need_then: YourStory in Nov 2021 describes demand among 15 to 30 year olds for help with phone, porn and social media addiction.

branding.domain_note: Company site is blockerx.net, not an atmana domain.

brand_strength.rationale: BlockerX is the public brand and appears in 2026 buyer guides as a mid-tier option; the Atmana parent name is hardly known.

outcome_analysis: Atmana raised a reported 500K dollar seed after the Summer 2021 batch and continues to operate BlockerX, which appears in 2026 guides. There is no evidence of a larger round or exit, so it looks like a small, steady consumer app business with weak defensibility against platform tools.
notes: Seed amount from seedtable and YourStory (two sources, round amount reported by press via YourStory snippet only; treat as moderately verified). Competitors such as Covenant Eyes, Qustodio, Opal exist but only 2026 listings were found, so no dated competitor list. YC lists Dubai; YourStory and Dealroom say Bengaluru. Founder surname per YourStory; YC shows Tejas Bala. YourStory page itself returned 403 and was read via search snippets.
